classes.name: Two-photon lithography and micro/nano printing systems
classes.scope: Two-photon/multiphoton polymerization and grayscale direct laser writing; excludes UV mask aligners and electron-beam writers.

classes.name: Cryogenic grid vitrification systems
classes.scope: Grid plunge/jet/blotless vitrification for cryo-TEM of hydrated dispersions; excludes bulk high-pressure freezers and freeze dryers.

classes.name: Magnetic-property measurement systems (SQUID/VSM)
classes.scope: Complete SQUID and VSM magnetic-property systems, including configured PPMS+VSM; not particle separation magnets or Hall-only gaussmeters.

classes.name: ICP-OES elemental analysis
classes.scope: Inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy for elemental analysis of prepared/digested samples. Not ICP-MS or UV-visible absorption.

classes.name: Contact stylus profilometry
classes.scope: Mechanical stylus surface height, film thickness and roughness measurement; distinct from optical profilometry and AFM.

classes.name: Nanoindentation and nanomechanical testing
classes.scope: Instrumented nanoindentation/nanoscratch platforms for nanoscale mechanical response; equipment configuration and sample preparation determine suitability.

classes.name: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS)
classes.scope: Surface elemental and chemical-state analysis using XPS/ESCA; not powder X-ray diffraction.

classes.name: Auger electron spectroscopy systems
classes.scope: Surface elemental/chemical-state analysis by Auger electron spectroscopy. Not XPS or SEM-EDS. Vacuum, sample and beam-damage constraints remain model-specific.

classes.name: Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation monitoring
classes.scope: QCM instruments that measure dissipation in addition to frequency. Includes ring-down QCM-D and explicitly labelled bandwidth/impedance-derived dissipation; measurement methods are distinguished. Frequency-only QCM is excluded.

classes.name: X-ray fluorescence spectrometers
classes.scope: Bulk, handheld or micro-XRF elemental analysis with element range and calibration specific to configuration. TRACER III cannot quantify carbon; trace-metal screening does not identify nanoparticle size.

classes.name: X-ray microscopy and tomography
classes.scope: X-ray micro/nano-CT and 3D X-ray microscopy. Spatial resolution differs from voxel size; only features resolvable for the model, sample and contrast can be interpreted.

manufacturer_rows.verification_notes: Official annual report documents 1975/1976 origins. University of Illinois Chicago Nanotechnology Core Facility documents P-7 scientific facility use.
Official history documents founding in 1934. Scientific Reports primary paper (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-02826-x, Surface roughness methods explicitly names Surftest SJ-210 with a diamond stylus.
Official company history describes NanoTest sales since 1992. Rutgers AMSL documents NanoTest Vantage. A 2026 Rtec acquisition does not make the instrument brand defunct.
Official ULVAC-PHI history documents multiple decades of surface analysis systems. Stanford and MIT independently document PHI installations.
Official newsletter describes AXIS launches in 2003 and 2014 and longstanding Shimadzu ownership. UNSW documents AXIS Supra+ scientific facility use.

research_limitations: Exactly ten distinct model profiles per class, including legacy models. Aliases are not separate profiles.

classes.name: Auger electron spectroscopy systems
classes.scope: Surface elemental/chemical-state analysis by Auger electron spectroscopy. Not XPS or SEM-EDS. Vacuum, sample and beam-damage constraints remain model-specific.

classes.name: Quartz crystal microbalance with dissipation monitoring
classes.scope: QCM instruments that measure dissipation in addition to frequency. Includes ring-down QCM-D and explicitly labelled bandwidth/impedance-derived dissipation; measurement methods are distinguished. Frequency-only QCM is excluded.

classes.name: X-ray fluorescence spectrometers
classes.scope: Bulk, handheld or micro-XRF elemental analysis with element range and calibration specific to configuration. TRACER III cannot quantify carbon; trace-metal screening does not identify nanoparticle size.

classes.name: X-ray microscopy and tomography
classes.scope: X-ray micro/nano-CT and 3D X-ray microscopy. Spatial resolution differs from voxel size; only features resolvable for the model, sample and contrast can be interpreted.
